notes: Improves the in-app RA/COSHH RA/SSW/Toolbox Talk creator by replacing checklist-style free-text boxes with repeatable one-line entries. Each item has a + Add button and a - remove button; Enter adds the next line. Existing drafts remain compatible because values continue to be stored as newline-separated text. Applied to structured hazards/controls/actions, SSW sequence/pre-start/stop/completion items, and Toolbox Talk controls/reminders/questions/actions while retaining narrative and SDS-source fields as normal text areas. Includes v2.10.49 Register/upload repairs and v2.10.48 PTW Viewer privacy masking. No database migration required.
